Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's it from this one-sided affair. India have dominated the first game and have taken a lead in this series. Nothing worked in England's favour in this game, but they are a dangerous side and will be back stronger! The action stays in the city of London, as we move to the Home of Cricket, Lord's for the second ODI. That game is all set to begin at 5.30 pm IST (12.00 pm GMT). But as you know our build-up will begin much in advance. Do join us then. For now, it's goodbye!

Jasprit Bumrah is the Player of the Match. He says there was some swing and some seam movement and these were good signs for the pacers and he was very happy there was help for them. Adds when he bowled the first ball, he saw there was some swing and they tried to exploit that. Adds when the ball is doing something, one does not have to try a lot. Just land the ball in the right areas. Adds he is very happy for Shami and says he has been bowling really well. Ends by saying Pant was really good too.

Rohit Sharma the skipper of India says it was the right call at the toss, they wanted to make use of the overhead conditions and they did. States they never really worry about the conditions they have the players to exploit any conditions and today it was suitable for the pacers and they did really well. Mentions the new ball bowlers were excellent. States that he enjoys playing with Dhawan, he is an experienced player and has scored a lot of runs in such conditions. Says the pull shot is a high-risk shot but it came off well today.

Jos Buttler the skipper of England says it was a really tough day to take but they need to forget and look forward to the game in Lord's. Mentions they were surprised by the movement they got earlier on and credit to India for exploiting the situation. States they will discuss about how things went in this game. Adds Jasprit Bumrah is a really good bowler and he is one of the best and it is a challenge facing him. Ends by saying it is never easy to force wickets and the bowlers were asked to take risks and take wickets but it did not happen.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in this game, Rohit Sharma won the all-important toss and made the right decision of bowling first. The Indian seamers were breathing fire in the first half of the game, they used the conditions perfectly. Jasprit Bumrah, in particular. He grabbed 6 wickets in this game and demolished England's batting line-up. Mohammad Shami as well took 3 scalps and reached 150 ODI wickets! They bundled out the home side for just 110 runs at the end. In reply, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan chased down the target with ease.

It's been a dominant display with the ball and an empathic show with the bat for India! Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan have made a mockery of this chase and this green pitch. India's opening pair started playing with a bit of caution early on, but they did not take time to step on the gas. Once Rohit Sharma got going, it was very tough to stop him. After this game, it's safe to say that Rohit Sharma is one of the finest players of the short ball in World Cricket. Rohit Sharma scored an unbeaten 76, while Shikhar Dhawan played the perfect role of the anchor and scored a solid 31. The duo put together their 18th 100-run stand in ODIs!

The hosts will be thoroughly disappointed here with their effort. Their bowlers could not really do much with only 110 runs on the board. They did try hard but they did not get much movement from this pitch as the Indian seamers did. They failed with the bat and have failed to grab even a wicket. They kept bowling short and were punished every time! It's been a tough loss for England and with this Jos Buttler's ODI captaincy begins with a defeat.

A comprehensive victory for India! Well, it was always going to be a cakewalk for them chasing a target of 111. It's the strong opening pair of India that has breezed past through the target within 20 overs and have taken a 1-0 lead in this series. A complete performance from the visitors, while a disheartening defeat for the home side.
FOUR! Rohit finishes it off in style! Shorter and on off, Dhawan pushes it through covers, this one races away to the fence. INDIA WIN BY 10 WICKETS!
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

SIX! BANG! Just the two needed now! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled over the fine leg fence for a biggie. Carse has not learnt. He has continously bowled short to Rohit and he has been hit for a biggie.
Two more! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket. Two taken. India only 8 away now.
Doing it in singles at the moment! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
100 up for India! Brilliant by the two openers! 19th century stand in ODIs between these two. Shorter and on off, this is guided through point for one.
Two more! Dhawan steps out and whips it over mid-wicket, not off the middle but gets two.
On the stumps, blocked.
On the stumps, this is pushed to cover.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
DRINKS! India are just 14 runs away from crossing the line. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan have put on quite a show here. Well, there is nothing that England can do to save this game now.
Two more! Angled into middle, Rohit works it through mid-wicket and takes two.
SIX! This is brilliant from Sharma! India winthin touching distance of the target now! Fractionally short but it was on the body, Sharma helps it on its way over the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Carved away! Rohit makes room and Carse goes for a yorker but ends up serving a full toss on off, it is hit through point for a boundary.
Another back of a length ball on off, Sharma hangs back and defends.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
SIX! BANG! That has gone all the way! Short and on the body, this is pulled over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Flatter and on off, defended.
Fuller and outside off, Dhawan hits it through covers and takes two.
Tossed up, this is eased down to long off for one.
On off, blocked.
Flatter and on off, Sharma pushes it to covers.
The paddle sweep comes out, it is played fine on the leg side for two.
Moeen Ali is introduced into the attack.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call it is! Not a bad review. Could have gone eitherway! On off, angling into the batter. Sharma swings across the line. He misses and it hits the pad. A huge appeal but turned down. It goes towards third man and the batters take one. Leg bye signaled. England take a review but the ball shows to be clipping the top of the stumps.
Review! England have taken a review against Rohit Sharma for an LBW appeal! Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates it was clipping the middle stump but it's the umpire's call. Not out it is!
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Fuller and on off, Sharma pushes it towards cover.
Ran with the shot there! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Another one on the off pole. Dhawan pushes it to covers.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Dhawan looks to flick but misses. Wided.
On the off pole, Dhawan gets right behind the line and defends.
A single to end a tidy over by Stokes! On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Angled into the pads, Rohit looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Really well bowled by Stokes so far! Rohit steps out, the length is shortened and on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Good length and on off, Sharma pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Sharma is beaten as he tries to block.
Swing and a miss! That was there to be hit! Full and outside off, Sharma looks to go down the ground. He misses. Probably should have tried to hit that over cover.
Ben Stokes comes into the attack now.
Another one on the shorter side, kept out.
On off, this is defended nicely.
Around off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, Rohit slashes but misses.
Sent back in time! Shorter and around off, Sharma guides it to point. Dhawan sets off for one but is sent back in time.
FOUR! Wonderfully played! Outside off, Sharma opens the face and then guides it past point. Just used the pace of the bowler.
Brydon Carse comes into the attack.
On a length, around middle and leg. Shikhar Dhawan makes room and blocks it out.
Fuller now, around middle. Rohit Sharma pushes it firmly past the bowler, towards mid on, and takes a single. Craig Overton falls down on his follow-through but he seems fine!

Overthrow now! Fuller now, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan dabs it towards point. Shikhar Dhawan sets off for a single, but he is sent back. There is a throw at keeper's end but no there is backing up there! A single is taken at the end!
FOUR! Pulled away! This its Shikhar Dhawan! Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Shikhar Dhawan pulls it past square leg for a boundary.
Wide! Short and down the leg side. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone.
Outside off, fuller this time. Rohit Sharma opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards point for a single.
On a length, outside off. Rohit Sharma blocks it out.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Shikhar Dhawan blocks it out.
Outside off, shorter ball. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone.
Too short on this occasion, around middle and off. Shikhar Dhawan tries to pull this one but bails out in the end.
Short of a length, this one is angling in, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan taps it to square leg again.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan skips down the pitch again, and flicks it to square leg.
Fuller now, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan dances down the pitch and pushes it towards mid on.
FOUR! Rohit Sharma is born to play the short ball! Craig Overton drops it short, around middle Rohit Sharma pulls it again, towards fine leg for a boundary!
SIX! Exquisite! Short ball, around middle and off. Rohit Sharma pulls this high over deep square leg for a biggie.
Length, around middle. Rohit Sharma blocks it out.
This one nips back in, around middle and leg, on a legnth. Rohit Sharma misses his flick and gets hit high on his thigh pads.
Shaping away now, outside off, on a length. Rohit Sharma leaves it alone.
Fullish ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma taps it towards point for a single.
Another length ball, shaping away, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone.
Well bowed! Outside off, a length ball. Shikhar Dhawan tries to poke this one but he misses.
Full, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan blocks it out towards mid-wicket.
A length ball again, tailing back in, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan shuffles across and tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
On a length, nipping in a tad, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan looks to flick this but he gets a slight inside edge back onto his pads. A stifled appeal there for LBW, but the umpire says no!
Very full on this occasion, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan blocks it out with a flat bat.
Outside off, a length ball. Shikhar Dhawan steers it down to third man for a single. He retains the strike!
Beaten now! On a length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan looks to have a poke at it but he misses.
Fuller now, around middle. Rohit Sharma flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side. Rohit Sharma leaves it alone. Wide called!
FOUR! This is way too easy for the Indian skipper! Shorter, around middle and off. Rohit Sharma swivels and pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another short one, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan miscues his pull to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on the thigh pads. Shikhar Dhawan misses his flick and gets rapped on his thigh pad.
Wide! Shorter ball, down the leg side. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length, around middle. Rohit Sharma defends it out.

FOUR! Another short ball and this has been punished by Rohit Sharma once again! On middle this time, Rohit Sharma pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes a couple of bounced over the ropes for the third boundary in the over!
A fuller ball, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick single.

FOUR! Shikhar Dhawan gets going now! He took his time to settle in but he is finding some rhythm now. Another overpitched ball, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan presses forward and drives it beautifully through cover for another boundary.
FOUR! This time he times it to perfection and gets the desired result! Overpitched, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan drives it firmly past the diving fielder at mid off for a boundary.
Pitches it up, around off. Shikhar Dhawan dances down the pitch and drives it uppishly over cover. Not perfectly timed this one! Two taken!
Wide! Some movement there for Reece Topley! This is bowled on a fuller length, wide of off, shaping away. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone. Wide called!
Fraction shorter now, around off. Rohit Sharma gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.
FOUR! Deft touch! Another length ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma stays in his crease, opens the face of the bat a tad, and guides it towards third man for a boundary.
Shaping away, on a length, at 138 clicks, outside off. Rohit Sharma leaves it alone.
Nicley played this time! Craig Overton pitches it up this time, around middle. Rohit Sharma steps down the pitch, makes room and flicks it past mid-wicket for a brace.
Beaten! Well bowled! On a length, shaping away a tad, outside off. Rohit Sharma hangs back and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Craig Overton begins with a good-length delivery, darting this one on the pads, at 134 clicks. Shikhar Dhawan tucks it towards square leg for a single.
A length ball, around off. Rohit Sharma prods forward and blocks it watchfully.
Tad fuller, width on offer now. Rohit Sharma dabs it towards short third man.
Back of a length, outside off. Rohit Sharma pushes it towards cover.
SIX! KABOOM! A short ball is a gift to Rohit Sharma! David Willey hits the deck hard, around middle. Rohit Sharma swivels and pulls this over fine leg for a biggie.
Very full on this occasion, around middle. Rohit Sharma looks to flick this but the ball goes off the leading edge towards cover.
Good-length delivery, around off. Rohit Sharma defends it out.
Pulls his length back, around the off pole again. Shikhar Dhawan pushes it firmly towards cover.
Outside off, a length delivery. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone. Shikhar Dhawan is in no hurry here!
Beaten again! Tad shorter, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan hangs back and tries to have a poke at it but he gets beaten on the outside edge again.
Another short one, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan get on top of the bounce and dabs it towards point.
Beaten! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan lunges forward to drive but he gets beaten on the outside edge.

Oh, close one there! Fuller one, around middle. Rohit Sharma drives it straight down the ground. David Willey manages to get his left hand towards the ball. The ball deflects off his fingers and goes towards the stumps. But Shikhar Dhawan gets bakc in time!
On the pads now, length delivery. Shikhar Dhawan tucks it towards fine leg and takes a single. He gets off the mark with that!
Tight line! Another length ball, around off. Shikhar Dhawan blocks it out off the back foot.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Shikhar Dhawan tries to flick this one but he gets a leading edge towards cover. No run there!
Tad shorter now, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan defends it out solidly.
On a length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan taps it towards point.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Reece Topley drops it short now, around middle and off. Rohit Sharma makes room and goes for the pull shot. But the ball goes off the top edge over Jos Buttler towards fine leg for a boundary.

Who will bowl from the other end? Reece Topley it is!
An appeal for an LBW, but the umpire says no! On a length, this one nips back in, around middle and leg. Shikhar Dhawan tries to flick this but he misses. That was sliding down leg.
On middle, on a length. Shikhar Dhawan taps it towards point.
This one shapes away a tad, outside off, a length ball. Shikhar Dhawan is beaten while trying to block this one.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan once again lets that go through. Not much movement there!
On a length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan leaves it alone.

Risky single to start proceedings! On a length, around middle and leg. Rohit Sharma tucks it towards square leg. He gets across to the other end. Shikhar Dhawan leaves his crease late. Jonny Bairstow has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. Shikhar Dhawan was nowhere near the crease, he had given up. But India are underway with that!
